title: Page Change Monitor output
description: One row per URL checked, saying whether the watched part changed since the previous run, plus a run summary.

results.title: Checked pages
results.description: One item per URL: the selector used, whether it changed, the text before and after, the fingerprint, the HTTP status and the error when there is one.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: URLs requested, URLs read, changes detected, first checks, errors and how many events were charged.
